author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
The 2025-26 season for Warhammer 40,000 Kill Team concludes with a two-level game mode and a big Boss Battle as well as a fast-moving melee Astartes Kill Team and the sacrificial Insidiants. 

The fast-moving Jump Packs of the Raptor Murderwings make this ultra-mobile Astartes kill team hard to avoid. Couple a heap of unblockable damage and APL reductions and this in-your-face kill team will get up close and personal fast. Let's check them out!

Thanks to Games Workshop for the complimentary advance copy of the box to review.
